close_reason: Fixed: removed redundant to_lowercase() call in IssuerDnContains::matches; substring is pre-lowercased by DeviationStore::add.
description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:311 — DeviationScope::IssuerDnContains(matches) calls substring.to_lowercase().as_str() on every call to matches(), allocating a String each time. The invariant from DeviationStore::add() guarantees the stored substring is already lowercase. Fix: compare directly against substring.as_str() (no to_lowercase needed). The to_lowercase call is dead work proportional to the number of cert evaluations times the number of IssuerDnContains deviations.
title: R1: deviation.rs: redundant to_lowercase() in IssuerDnContains::matches
